text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-M-03, Baudrillard Brushed Stainless Steel Knob

The Baudrillard Cabinet Knob by Acorn is made out of stainless steel with a brushed stainless steel finish. It is perfect for modern style homes and the unique, contemporary shape will be sure to add the perfect finishing touch to your kitchen cabinets as well as any other small, light weight doors in your home. It's easy to grip, easy to clean, and easy to install.

Also Available Matching Baudrillard Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Baudrillard Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: .77"
  • Projection: 1.27"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
